surfaces.part: upper peak of rock, lit facets

answer.evidence: The rock is a faceted mound that widens from a pointed peak (width 3 at row 1) to 28 px at rows 31-34, then narrows to a rounded base at rows 40-44. The main body has a bright lit plane at rows 26-36 (column x=16 is white, L=255, for rows 28-36). It ends at an edge, and darker, shaded face rows follow at 37-43 (L≈126 and 96-126). That reads as a top or sloped plane over a front face. The upper peak at rows 1-14 is lit facets with no edge line or ellipse. The evidence is moderate: it is an irregular organic shape, not a built volume, but it does have a top plane and a front face of 3+ rows.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a grey, gourd-shaped rock stack (crag), not a tree with a canopy and trunk, so it does not match the reference kind. It has about 4 grey steps: white highlight, light grey, mid grey and dark grey. The measured facts show 100% near-neutral dark edge pixels, which matches the visible near-black outline, whereas both references have 0% and use tinted dark-material edges. Its visible tones per tile (10) are above tree-1a786c (7) but well below tree-d43edd (29). Near-flat coverage is 12%, against 0% for both references, and the large smooth highlight patches on the top lobes read as flat fills. The stones are not shaded one by one, and the sticker-like neutral outline is the shallow look the Beodeul standard avoids. Fail on the neutral outline, flat patches and shallow ramps.

The main one is the ledge at rows 26-31, where the x=22 scan shows white L=255 turning to dark L=96 at row 32. The x=16 scan shows a white ledge at rows 28-36 above the darker face at rows 37-44. A grey rocky front face of about 13 rows (32-44) sits below the lit ledge. The upper plane at rows 18-22 is bounded below by dark rows 21-24 in the x=16 and x=22 scans. There is no isometric side face; the dark patches on the right are shading on the south-facing rock. Because it is irregular rock rather than a built form, the top evidence is looser than for a cabinet or table, but lit tops over darker faces are present.
